# Preliminary

```{r}
#| label: library-import
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(kableExtra)
library(stats)
library(broom)

gum <- read_csv("gumR2026.csv") |> 
  filter(trtgroup != "Placebo")


```

# Questions

```{r}
#| label: q1
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE

## Continuous GLM

model_1 <- glm(
  mut3mos ~ trtgroup,
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = gum
) 

summary(model_1)

kable(tidy(model_1, conf.int = TRUE),
      digits = 3)

```

## Answer 1

The treatment effect estimate is -1.326 (cfu/ml) and it has a 95% confidence interval of (-1.96 to -0.690). This effect is statistically significant (p-value \< 0.05).

The treatment effect has a slope of zero because the treatment effect doesnt depend on the baseline MS level.

```{r}
#| label: q2
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE

## Interaction Model

model_2 <- glm(
  mut3mos ~ trtgroup * mutpre,
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = gum
) 

summary(model_2)

kable(tidy(model_2, conf.int = TRUE),
      digits = 3)


```

## Answer 2

The treatment effect estimate is -0.004 (cfu/ml) with a 95% confidence interval of (-0.826 to 0.818).

The mean model is the following:

$$
E(Y) = \beta_0 + (\beta_1 \times \text{trtgroup} )+ (\beta_2 \times \text{mutpre} )+ (\beta_3 \times (\text{trtgroup} \times \text{baseline})
)
$$



When we add in the coefficients the mean model becomes:


$$
E(Y) = -1.303 + (3.235 \times \text{trtgroup} )+ (0.858 \times \text{mutpre} )- (0.421 \times (\text{trtgroup} \times \text{baseline}))
$$
# Question 3
```{r}
#| label: tbl-patient-1
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE  
#| tbl-cap: "Treatment Effect for Patient 1"
#| tbl-cap-location: top


patient_1 <- tibble(mutpre = 5.29)

pred_1 <- predict(
  model_2,
  new_data = patient_1,
  se.fit = TRUE
)

patient_1_treatment_effect <- tibble(
  estimate = pred_1$fit,
  conf.low = pred_1$fit - 1.96 * pred_1$se.fit,
  conf.high = pred_1$fit + 1.96 * pred_1$se.fit
)

kable(patient_1_treatment_effect, digits = 3)
```


```{r}
#| label: tbl-patient-2
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE

#| tbl-cap: "Treatment Effect for Patient 2"

)

patient_2_treatment_effect <- tibble(
  estimate = pred_2$fit,
  conf.low = pred_2$fit - 1.96 * pred_2$se.fit,
  conf.high = pred_2$fit + 1.96 * pred_2$se.fit
)

patient_2 <- tibble(mutpre = 0)


kable(patient_2_treatment_effect, digits = 3)


```
